title: StepFun Unveils Step 5 Preview for Long-Horizon Agents
summary: StepFun’s new 600-billion-parameter sparse model targets software, research and finance agents with a one-million-token context window.
body:
StepFun has introduced Step 5 Preview, its new flagship model for agentic work, in a release timed for the Asian daytime cycle. The model is described as a 600-billion-parameter sparse mixture-of-experts system, with roughly 27 billion parameters activated per token, a one-million-token context window and native image input.

## Built for extended professional tasks

StepFun positions the preview around work that requires more than a single answer: software engineering, large-scale research, structured analysis and interactive reporting. Finance is a particular focus, with the company highlighting source verification, valuation work and the ability to sustain multi-step investigations.

The model is available through StepFun’s preview interface and documentation, but the launch needs to be read carefully. This is an API and preview-model release, not yet a completed open-weight release. StepFun’s materials indicate that model weights are planned for a later date. That distinction matters for teams deciding whether to build around the model or merely test it.

## Why it matters

Step 5 Preview arrives as Chinese AI companies increasingly compete on agent reliability and work completion rather than headline benchmark scores alone. Its combination of a large context window, visual input and long-horizon execution is aimed directly at the same professional workflows being targeted by leading US and European labs.

The immediate significance is strategic: StepFun is trying to make an Asian-developed model part of the global agent stack before its weights become available. The unresolved questions are equally important—how the model performs on independent evaluations, how stable its preview capacity is, and whether the eventual open release will carry a permissive license and practical deployment requirements.
title_zh: 阶跃星辰发布 Step 5 Preview，主攻长程智能体任务
summary_zh: 阶跃星辰推出面向软件、研究和金融工作的 Step 5 Preview，采用 6000 亿参数稀疏架构并支持百万字上下文。
body_zh:
阶跃星辰发布新旗舰模型 Step 5 Preview，面向智能体工作场景，发布时间落在本期覆盖的亚洲白天时段。官方介绍称，该模型采用总参数量 6000 亿的稀疏混合专家架构，每个 Token 激活约 270 亿参数，支持百万 Token 上下文和原生图像输入。

## 面向持续数小时的专业工作

StepFun 将 Step 5 Preview 定位为处理复杂、多步骤任务的模型，覆盖软件工程、大规模研究、结构化分析和交互式报告等场景。金融工作是其重点方向之一，官方强调了信息核验、估值分析以及持续完成长链路调查的能力。

不过，这次发布需要区分“可调用预览”和“开放权重”。目前用户可以通过 StepFun 的预览入口和文档体验模型，但它还不是已经完成的开源权重发布。StepFun 的公开材料显示，模型权重计划在稍后开放。对于准备把模型接入生产系统的团队来说，这一差别直接关系到可控性、迁移成本和供应稳定性。

## 为什么重要

Step 5 Preview 体现出中国模型公司竞争重点的变化：行业关注点正从单项榜单成绩，转向智能体能否稳定完成真实工作。长上下文、视觉输入和长程执行能力，正好对应美国和欧洲实验室争夺的企业级工作流市场。

它当前最重要的意义，是阶跃星辰试图在权重开放前，先把一个中国开发的模型放进全球智能体工具链。真正决定其影响力的，还包括独立评测结果、预览服务的稳定性，以及未来权重是否采用足够宽松的许可证并具备实际部署条件。

sources.title: Step 5 Preview: what StepFun's 600B flagship really ships

featured_reason: It is the edition’s clearest Asian-cycle launch of a frontier-scale model aimed at practical autonomous knowledge work.
featured_reason_zh: 这是本时段最具代表性的亚洲模型发布，直接把前沿规模与专业智能体工作结合起来。
cat_take_zh: Step 5 的百万上下文很醒目，但权重尚未开放，当前价值仍取决于预览服务稳定性。
cat_take_en: The million-token context is notable, but until weights arrive, Step 5’s practical value rests on preview-service reliability.
